_doc: plan-9000 S1: the observatory's ONE action catalog. Every caller (the Ctrl-K palette, the voice model, an agent's command row) reaches the screen only through these actions, gated by the matrix. The browser executor (observatory/web/src/pilot) and the server/MCP side (observatory/pilot/catalog.py) both read THIS file, so there is nothing to keep in sync. A missing matrix cell is DENY; an action with no class is treated as actuate. A principal is never a value a caller passes: the executor has one entry point per principal (a1 #44141 R1). Schemas use only the keywords the validator implements (tests/test_pilot_s1.py checks).

_classes.view: changes only what this page shows; nothing is stored or sent
_classes.read: reads org data back to the caller
_classes.compose: changes the owner's own workspace (a draft in the message box, who a chat is with); never a wire message, never production
_classes.write: sends or stores something on the owner's behalf (a wire message): the owner's tap, always
_classes.actuate: acts on a machine (a desktop): the owner's tap, always

principals.owner: the palette in a tab holding the owner key. Its write and actuate still go through the confirm: only a trusted pointer click on the prompt rendered for that request runs them (#44109, a1 #44141 R3)
principals.visitor: the palette in a tab without the owner key
principals.room: the realtime model: whoever is audible (owner, TV, guest); its calls are never trusted DOM events
principals.agent: a resident's command row, arriving over the SSE stream (S4)
principals.anonymous: an SSE client without the owner key: receives no command rows
principals.peer: a federated org: not a caller

actions.name: navigate
actions.description: Go to one of the observatory's views.

actions.name: open_thread
actions.description: Open one wire thread by its key (for example plan-9000).

actions.name: open_agent
actions.description: Open an agent's profile panel by its name.

actions.name: close_panel
actions.description: Close whatever panel or overlay is open (agent profile, desktop view).

actions.name: set_theme
actions.description: Switch the colour theme.

actions.name: cycle_theme
actions.description: Step to the next or previous colour theme.

actions.name: scroll
actions.description: Scroll the current view.

actions.name: get_view_state
actions.description: What is on screen now: the view's NAME, the open agent panel, the theme. Never a URL or query string.

actions.name: get_usage
actions.description: The org's plan-limit gauges: 5-hour and 7-day percent used, and when each resets.

actions.name: list_goals
actions.description: Goals on the board in one state: their ids and titles.

actions.name: open_desktop
actions.description: Open the live view of the desktop an agent is using, where the owner can also act on it.

actions.name: read_screen
actions.description: What the owner is looking at right now: the page, its visible headings, the open conversation's title, agent and last few lines, the visible table and chart captions. Numbers that look like phone or account ids and anything secret-looking arrive masked.

actions.name: point_at
actions.description: Point at something on screen by its visible words (a heading, a button, a conversation, a chart caption): your figure glides to it and it lights up for a moment.

actions.name: open_conversation
actions.description: Open one of the owner's chat conversations by (part of) its title. Opens the chat workspace if needed.

actions.name: search
actions.description: Search everything in the chat workspace (conversations, messages, files, agents) for some words and show the results.

actions.name: open_file
actions.description: Open a file from the open conversation in the side panel, by (part of) its name.

actions.name: dance
actions.description: Do a short happy dance on screen: when the owner asks for it, or to celebrate something that worked.

actions.name: switch_agent
actions.description: Hand the open chat to another agent (it starts fresh from here; nothing is sent to anyone).

actions.name: type_in_composer
actions.description: Write words into the chat's message box as a draft. Nothing is sent: sending is send_message, which the owner taps to allow.

actions.name: send_message
actions.description: Send a message in the open chat conversation, to its agent. Waits for the owner's tap on Allow; the prompt shows the exact words.
